narrative:
Coshocton County has 21,645 registered voters, with 54.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 34.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 11.7%, a pronounced Republican lean of 22.6 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.0% of registrants.
